jawVsNeckWires._method:
How close the open jaw comes to the neck-side wire spans, compared with how close it comes to the neck itself.

For every pose of the policy and pickup sets with the jaw open (40 deg) and closed (0 deg), exact smallest gaps
(manifold3d min_gap, 10 mm search) between the jaw frame and
  (a) each wire span of a route below the head (the conductor group as a tube of radius r = 1.7 mm, a flat group of
      eight wires lying two deep; the tube follows the taut centreline between the clip points), and
  (b) the parts the span lies on (torso shell, ID12/ID11 cases and links, head-pitch bracket).
Poses where the jaw already touches a neck part (gap < 0.2 mm) cannot be reached by the robot itself and are reported
separately; in the remaining (reachable) poses the wire group must stay clear of the jaw. Routes from route-candidates.json; spans on bodies below the
head only. Writes jaw-check.json.
Usage: jaw_check.py [route ...]

yawSlack._method:
Slack needed by each free span of a route as a function of head yaw alone (FK only, taut spans; seconds to run).
Answers how much loop the yaw crossing needs for a chosen hand-turning limit (the V1.8 guide allows about +-80 deg).
Writes yaw-slack.json. Usage: yaw_slack.py [route ...]

loopSpaceBesideBracket._method:
Where the yaw/roll service loop can hang beside the head-pitch bracket without being reached by a moving part.

Grid in the head-pitch bracket's own frame (MJCF body neck_pitch; equal to the robot frame at q = 0), 1 mm voxels,
x 4..46, y -36..-14, z 60..104 (the -y side of the bracket under the head). At every pose of a pose set, every part on
another body (torso, neck, yaw link, head, jaw) is moved into the bracket frame and sliced exactly (manifold3d) at each
grid z; voxel centres inside a section are 'reached' at that pose. The bracket's own parts are occupied at every pose.
A voxel is 'always free' when no pose reaches it. Reports the always-free volume, its largest inscribed sphere (EDT on
the 1 mm grid, so +-0.5 mm), and the always-free space within 6 mm outside the bracket's -y plate (where a loop held by
the bracket clip would lie), per z band. Pose sets: policy (jaw 0 only, and jaw 0 + 40) and pickup, from motion.py.
Writes loop-space.json.
